A pursuit of mastery in audio engineering.

Boom for Mobile isn't just an equalizer—it's a complete audio ecosystem. We've engineered our 3D surround sound technology to work with any pair of headphones, transforming your daily commute or workout into a private concert. Feel every beat, every bass drop, and every nuance the way the artist intended.

Prime Features

Everything you need to elevate your listening experience.

3D Surround Sound

Experience mind-blowing 3D Surround Sound on ANY headphones. You'll feel like you're in the studio with the artist.

Equalizer Presets

Choose from 29 handcrafted EQ presets or create your own to make every song sound exactly how you want it.

Audio Intensity Slider

Control the intensity of the audio effects to perfectly match your listening environment and preferences.

Stream Tidal with Boom

Experience your favorite Tidal tracks in high-fidelity 3D Surround Sound directly within the Boom app.

20,000+ Radio & Podcasts

Access thousands of internet radio stations and podcasts across 120 countries, all enhanced with Boom effects.

Discover your Music Universe

Boom seamlessly integrates with your favorite platforms so you can enjoy enhanced audio everywhere.

Dropbox & Google Drive

Stream all your personal music stored in the cloud with Boom effects.

Internet Radio

Access 20k+ internet radio stations across 120 countries.

Podcasts

Listen to thousands of podcasts with enhanced vocal clarity.

Tidal

Experience high-fidelity streaming like never before.

Local Library

Play all your downloaded tracks with 3D Surround Sound.
